The independent supplemental native transition review must preserve every printed solid, purchased interface, control and registry, allowing only the documented radio placement, adhesive metadata and source identity changes. Original detailed geometry review remains applicable by unchanged local-shape identity.
limits: Regression fixture approval only. Actual print fits/creep/adhesion, hardware seating, flexible wires, blade swept volume, installed mass/CG and payload/flight qualification remain unresolved.
